Instrument.name: Nikon D5 Camera
Instrument.description:
The Nikon D5 is a digital single-lens reflex (DSLR) camera utilizing a 20.8-megapixel FX-format (35.9 x 23.9 mm) CMOS sensor paired with an EXPEED 5 image-processing engine. This architecture is optimized for extreme low-light sensitivity, featuring a native ISO range of 100 to 102,400, expandable to an ISO 3,280,000 (Hi-5), enabling high-fidelity imaging in environments with minimal ambient light.
This is a "multi-instance" and "multi-host" instrument, meaning not a specific instrument but rather a type or model of instrument that may be used many times across one or more missions and is not associated with any specific host. Each of these instruments are functionally identical, although they may have instance-specific calibration information.
